issue_context.title: System.Drawing.Font Name and Unit properties are missing TypeConverterAttributes
issue_context.body: Both the `Font.Name` and `Font.Unit` properties are missing attributes for their respective type converters, `FontNameConverter` and `FontUnitConverter`. Both of these are included in `System.Windows.Extensions`. These missing type converters negatively affect how the font properties are displayed in the property grid control.
comments: We should fix this by adding attributes back and pointing to converters via string assembly qualified type name.
@DustinCampbell does this block any designer scenario, or is it just missing text in the property window? If the latter, we will likely move out at this point.
@danmosemsft this shouldn't be a big change that I can get soon-ish, however I'm focusing on the designer attributes that we're missing.
OK cool. I see there's several similar related issues. Great!
